svg.title: Find the three Windows certificate stores
svg.desc: Genuine VMware lab screenshot with numbered annotation overlays. 1. Personal: the application certificate belongs here with its matching private key. 2. Trusted Root: only explicitly approved trust anchors belong here. 3. Intermediate: the issuing CA chain belongs here. This image shows navigation only.
svg.text: GENUINE LAB CAPTURE · WINDOWS SERVER 2022 · NUMBERED ANNOTATIONS
Find the three Windows certificate stores
1. Personal: the application certificate belongs here with its matching private key.
2. Trusted Root: only explicitly approved trust anchors belong here.
3. Intermediate: the issuing CA chain belongs here. This image shows navigation only.
